text: Welcome to the clinic. I need to understand your new movement symptoms; can you describe exactly what movements you are experiencing and when they started? Also, have you been diagnosed with any psychiatric conditions or taking any psychiatric medications?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful; given your recent diagnosis of schizophrenia and the initiation of risperidone two months ago, I am concerned about drug-induced movement disorders.
